Faith & Inspiration

Quran & Hadith

A Quranic verse and Hadith that hold special meaning.

📖 Favourite Quran Verse

Surah Ar-Ra'd — 13:11

إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَا يُغَيِّرُ مَا بِقَوْمٍ حَتَّىٰ يُغَيِّرُوا مَا بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ

Innallāha lā yugayyiru mā bi-qawmin ḥattā yugayyirū mā bi-anfusihim.

"Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change what is in themselves."

Surah Ar-Ra'd, 13:11
✦ Favourite Hadith

Tamim Ad-Dari (رضي الله عنه)

لَيَبْلُغَنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرُ مَا بَلَغَ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ، وَلَا يَتْرُكُ اللَّهُ بَيْتَ مَدَرٍ وَلَا وَبَرٍ إِلَّا أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ هَذَا الدِّينَ

"This matter (Islam) will reach wherever the night and day reach, and Allah will not leave a single house, whether of clay or of hair (tents), without causing this religion to enter it."

Musnad Ahmad, 16957
